scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=ui
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test --workspace=server && npm test --workspace=ui
scripts.test:verbose: npm run test:verbose --workspace=server && npm run test:verbose --workspace=ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=server
scripts.check:fast: npm run build:shared && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck --workspace=@task-board/ui
scripts.check: npm run check:fast && npm run test --workspace=@task-board/server && npm run test --workspace=@task-board/ui
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=@task-board/server && npm run build --workspace=@task-board/ui
scripts.deploy:ui: cd ui && npx wrangler pages deploy dist/ui/browser --project-name=task-board-ui
